# NeuromorphicHardware

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Specialized hardware designed to emulate spiking neural networks, often using analog or mixed-signal circuits. Enables physical implementation of iNEST architectures, bridging the gap between neural algorithms and network infrastructure.
